create_StableAudioGaussianFourierProject: create a Gaussian Fourier projection layer for noise level embeddings with configurable embedding size and scale
build_StableAudioDiTBlock: build a Stable Audio transformer block with self-attention, cross-attention, and SwiGLU feed-forward layers
run_StableAudioDiTModel_forward: run the Stable Audio DiT model forward pass with hidden states, timestep, and encoder embeddings
configure_StableAudioDiTBlock_chunk_feed: configure chunked feed-forward computation on a Stable Audio DiT block by setting chunk size and dimension
set_StableAudioDiTModel_attn_processor: set the default Stable Audio attention processor on the DiT model to disable custom processors
